Message:
Following a roar that
resounded like the forest itself
crying out, a sharp wind rushed
towards the invaders.

The wind swept up
their weapons and flung them
far off into the distance.

As Brother and the others
closed in on the now
weaponless invaders,

they let out cries of
terror and fled.
Did I...protect the forest...?

While everyone
let out a victory cry,
Mother looked at me
with gentle,
but saddened eyes.

“Cu Sith...
Your wings were
magnificent...”

I see... I flew...
even without wings...
But...

I wasn’t the same as
everyone else after all...
I’m the same as that other,
terrifying animal...
“You are my daughter, Cu Sith.”

Mother then wrapped
her warm wings around me...

“Though we look different,
we are still family.
But...what do you think...?”

I’m the one who gets to
decide who I truly am.

When I looked around me,
the squirrels, rabbits,

and all the other animals of
the forest were looking at me
with kindness in their eyes.

There were those with wings,
and those with fangs.
Everyone looked different
from one another.
But, even so...
“Yes... We’re family...!”

I had wings all along too.
Mother taught me to find them...
And on those wings—
my wings of courage—

I’ll fly without wavering.
Because now, I believe I can...!
